newsitem.title: ZAMBIA: ZAMBIAN STOCKS WEEK - Rothmans Zambia leads trade.
newsitem.headline: ZAMBIAN STOCKS WEEK - Rothmans Zambia leads trade.

text.p: Traded volume rose on the Lusaka Stock Exchange in the week ended October 25, exchange officials said.
They said volume rose to 1,68 million shares valued at 41.4 million Zambia kwacha, from 124,099 shares worth 1,56 million kwacha last week.
Rothmans fell four kwacha to end the week at 30 kwacha in a traded volume of 1,23 million shares valued at 36,96 million kwacha.
Zambia Sugar fell three kwacha to end the week at 12 kwacha in a traded volumes of 115,000 shares valued at 1,38 kwacha.
Chilanga Cement remained steady at 55 kwacha in a traded volumes of 500 shares valued at 27,500 kwacha.
Zambia Consolidated Copper Mines and Farmers House saw no trade in the week.
